rationale: Retain FlexiVan as a distinct current I Squared portfolio company and correct the record to the February 18, 2020 legal close. American Intermodal Management was absorbed into FlexiVan, while Transportation Equipment Network is a separate platform whose disclosed lineage does not include FlexiVan. I Squared controls FlexiVan through its first global infrastructure fund; Castle & Cooke's announced minority retention and the exact ownership percentages are not publicly reconfirmed, so no additional current owner or percentage is inferred.

companyFieldUpdates.description: FlexiVan is a North American marine-chassis leasing and fleet-management platform serving ocean carriers, ports, logistics providers and drayage users. The company operates more than 120,000 chassis and offers pools, rentals, maintenance and AIM360 telematics across major U.S. intermodal markets. I Squared Capital completed its controlling investment on February 18, 2020 by combining American Intermodal Management into FlexiVan through its first global infrastructure fund. Castle & Cooke announced that it would retain a minority interest, but its current status and the parties' exact percentages are not publicly reconfirmed. Transportation Equipment Network is a distinct I Squared platform and is not consolidated into this record. No later FlexiVan sale, recapitalization or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
